motto: If you cannot grade your retrieval and your answer at the same time, you cannot ship the system. The two are not the same metric and the same prompt fails on different axes.

steps.body: If you cannot grade your retrieval and your answer at the same time, you cannot ship the system. The two are not the same metric and the same prompt fails on different axes.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: A RAG system has at least four moving parts: chunker, retriever, reranker, generator. Any of them can be the cause of a wrong answer. Without per-stage metrics you are flying blind.

A user reports a wrong answer. Is it because the chunker cut the answer span? Is it because the retriever did not include the chunk in top-k? Is it because the reranker pushed the right chunk past position one? Is it because the generator ignored the chunk and made something up? You cannot tell from the answer alone. You need:
